Behavior of Tangent Function

For 0º < t < 90º, tan(t) is strictly increasing from 0 to infinity. At the midpoint t = 45º, tan(45º) = 1.

Complementary Angle Properties

Trigonometric functions of complementary angles are directly related by: sin(90º − t) = cos(t) and cos(90º − t) = sin(t).

Trigonometric Identities

The foundational Pythagorean identity holds true for all possible values of t: sin²(t) + cos²(t) = 1.
